purpose: Map the smallest repository surface needed to design, validate, report, and hand off a future host-embedded Lua runtime without confusing contract proof with product-runtime proof.

directories.purpose: Lua embedding contract, workflows, artifacts, validators, fixtures, and schema.
Opt-in validation hooks; never installed implicitly.
Scoped agent procedures and promotion boundaries.
Windows and Linux hosted proof gates.

commands.name: Lua contract tests
commands.proof: contract, fixture, registry, and workflow semantics

commands.name: Build
commands.proof: product embedding requires a separately authorized runtime sprint

knownTraps: Do not treat a Lua executable on PATH as proof that AgentSwitchboard embeds Lua.
Do not make Lua the application main loop; the host owns startup, execution order, rollback, and teardown.
Do not share mutable VM state across isolation boundaries when independent states are required.
Do not allow script errors to unwind past the host boundary without a protected host catch and cleanup path.
Do not expose os, io, package, or debug by default; capabilities are host-registered allow-list entries.
Do not add JIT complexity as a prerequisite; interpreter-first remains the contract baseline.
Do not claim leak freedom because a state-close call exists; teardown must be observed under runtime evidence.
Do not hide behavior in ambient globals, implicit library exposure, or unreviewed metatable side effects for AI-authored snippets.
Lua-native table indexing is 1-based; do not add a 0-index compatibility layer merely for host-language familiarity.
When a requirement can remain in the host language, do not expand the scripting surface by default.
proofCeiling: Repository map and deterministic offline contracts only; no Lua installation, embedding API, VM lifecycle, sandbox enforcement, error tunneling, memory behavior, JIT behavior, performance, or product-runtime proof.
